# Relationship lunch: Brenmoor League

Date: 2026-09-18
Author: Tomas Ferreira

Attendees: Brenmoor commercial director, Tomas Ferreira.

- Commercial director said streaming usage is "up massively" since they moved all second-division matches onto our streams this season, and they are delighted.
- Renewal "basically agreed" at around +10%, pending their board.
- Integrity alerts continue to be valued by the league.

Actions: Tomas to send renewal paperwork.
